# usd-content-workspace

usd-content-workspace is the service foundation of Omniverse Content Services: APIs, reference services, conformance suites, and client examples for storage, permissions, user identity, metadata, notifications, endpoint discovery, and thumbnails on existing storage.

## Primary Docs

- README.md: product overview, component map, system requirements, licensing
- AGENTS.md: coding-agent guide, expert role, ground rules, repo layout, skill routing
- skills/usd-content-workspace-expert/SKILL.md: expert skill for choosing, connecting to, deploying, and implementing services
- skills/usd-content-workspace-expert/references/README.md: expert reference index (versions, stack, APIs, deployment, operations, development, testing)
- docs/README.md: documentation index

## Core Workflows

- Component map: docs/overview/components.md
- Choosing components: docs/getting_started/choosing_components.md
- Connecting to a deployment: docs/getting_started/connect.md
- Deploying a service: docs/getting_started/deploy.md
- Implementing a compatible service: docs/getting_started/implement.md
- Running Discovery, Storage, and Metadata as local processes: skills/local-process-stack/SKILL.md
- Storage API contract map: storage/api/skills/storage-api-contract-map/SKILL.md
- Storage Service docs map: storage/reference/storage-service/skills/storage-service/SKILL.md
- User Info Service docs map: user-identity/reference/microsoft-graph-userinfo-service/skills/userinfo-service-docs-map/SKILL.md

## Constraints

- Agents explain and recommend by default; build, install, or deploy only when asked.
- Component directories are released snapshots; change components in their source projects.
- Each component keeps its own version, toolchain, and deployment requirements.
- Naming: this stack is usd-content-workspace (the earlier name "Omniverse Storage APIs" is retired); "ovstorage" means only the client-side library.
- Prebuilt containers and Helm charts: https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/teams/omniverse/collections/storage_apis (catalog name and URL will change)
- Services are reference implementations; deployments are modular and any service can be replaced by one that implements the same contract.
